name: Dreadshift
summary: Dreadshift is a real-time, top-down co-op zombie survival game for one to six players. Players scavenge a town at night for weapons and evacuation supplies while waves of the dead rise every two and a half minutes, then reach an extraction point together. Noise attracts zombies, shots must be aimed at the body, and friendly fire is on by default. Solo players are joined by AI teammates. A six-chapter campaign branches toward different endings, and a separate run mode strings short nights together across the town, where players board up doors, set traps and tape found items into makeshift weapons.
